t: This is 76 Brook Street, a terrace house in Westminster. It was designed by Colen Campbell, a Scottish architect who lived from 1676 to 1729. Campbell is best known as a writer as well as a builder. He produced Vitruvius Britannicus, three volumes of high-quality engravings showing the great houses of his time. So the man behind this fairly modest street frontage was also someone who helped record the grand architecture of his age.
